claim_boundary: ACCEPTED_BOUNDED_CAPABILITY only; learned structural vocabulary over the finite pure R2.56 evaluator, not open-ended semantic/operator-language invention or AGI.
critical_unknowns: Base R2.56 opcode/evaluator semantics remain finite and host-designed; R2.57 learns abstractions over them rather than new evaluator semantics.
The abstraction-learning corpus is authored/synthetic and can encode generator-specific regularities despite MDL/compression gates.
External transfer covers one numeric ufunc family (linearstep); broad cross-domain or repository-level transfer is not established.
The active endpoint probe that exposes a normalized progress subgoal is harness-designed, not autonomously discovered from task uncertainty.
Large learned libraries still need stronger utility-aware eviction, versioning, dependency management, and scaling evidence.
Effectful/tool-family vocabulary invention and irreversible external-I/O rollback are not proven.
Independent challengers and counterfactual representation families remain insufficient for W5 convergence.
